name: The GigaCorp Compliance Monolith
title: Legacy Enterprise Silo & Digital Barrier Titan
description: A sprawling 50,000-seat university and health system facing a federal OCR audit. Department heads buy non-conforming SaaS software, PDFs lack tags, and IT treats accessibility as an afterthought. Coordinate your squad to research the Tech Tree, pierce the 3 elemental shields, and execute the Governance Capstone!

procurement.name: Procurement & Standards Aegis
procurement.desc: Armored by unchecked vendor VPAT claims and vague contract terms.

assistiveTech.name: Modality & Assistive Tech Barrier
assistiveTech.desc: Shielded by keyboard traps, missing ARIA live regions, and untagged documents.

governance.name: Organizational Inertia Barrier
governance.desc: Defended by lack of executive sponsorship and zero shift-left culture.

nodes.title: Section 508 Refresh & Federal Scope

buff.name: Legal Piercer
buff.desc: +25% extra damage on all future legal questions.

nodes.question: When GigaCorp procures third-party enterprise software for university staff using federal grant funds, what standard must the procurement team enforce under Section 508?

choices.text: The vendor may self-certify with an informal email promise to fix bugs within 5 years.
The vendor must provide an accredited Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) based on VPAT 2.4+ mapping to WCAG 2.1 AA.
Section 508 only applies to consumer hardware keyboards, not digital software.
Only open-source software is subject to Section 508 requirements.

nodes.explanation: Federal agencies and recipients of federal funds must require an official Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) generated via the current VPAT (Voluntary Product Accessibility Template) demonstrating WCAG 2.1 Level AA conformance.

nodes.title: European Standard EN 301 549 & Transnational Audits

buff.name: Auditor Precision
buff.desc: Automatically eliminates 1 incorrect distractor choice in the Capstone.

nodes.question: GigaCorp operates international research campuses across the EU. How does European Standard EN 301 549 Clause 9 compare to US Section 508 standards?

choices.text: EN 301 549 Clause 9 harmonizes directly with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, matching Section 508 ICT refresh requirements.
EN 301 549 replaces WCAG completely with European ISO typography metrics.
EN 301 549 only regulates physical elevators and ramp slopes, not digital ICT.
EN 301 549 exempts all higher education institutions from web accessibility.

nodes.explanation: EN 301 549 Clause 9 incorporates the WCAG success criteria verbatim for web content, ensuring global harmonization between European public procurement and US Section 508 standards.

nodes.title: Screen Reader Navigation & Heading Hierarchy

buff.name: Semantic Radar
buff.desc: Grants the squad +20s extra thinking time on all remaining nodes.

nodes.question: A blind doctoral researcher uses NVDA and JAWS to navigate GigaCorp's research portal. What is the most efficient way screen reader users skim page structure?

choices.text: Reading the entire page linearly from word 1 to the footer every time.
Pulling up the Elements List / Rotor to jump through hierarchical H1-H6 headings and landmark regions.
Disabling the screen reader and switching to high contrast monitor settings.
Repeatedly pressing Tab to reach text paragraphs.

nodes.explanation: Over 75% of screen reader users rely on hierarchical headings (H key or Rotor Elements list) and landmark regions to skim, orient, and jump to specific page content.

nodes.title: Single-Switch Access & Keyboard Trapping

buff.name: Shift-Left Aegis
buff.desc: Absorbs 1 future Boss counter-attack, preserving team health.

nodes.question: An engineering student with severe motor impairment navigates GigaCorp's LMS using a sip-and-puff single-switch device. Which barrier completely halts their ability to operate the platform?

choices.text: A modal dialog with a keyboard trap where focus cannot be dismissed using Esc or Tab.
Using a dark color scheme instead of white.
An avatar picture that lacks audio description.
Providing text transcripts alongside audio podcasts.

nodes.explanation: WCAG 2.1 SC 2.1.2 (No Keyboard Trap) is a catastrophic blocker for switch and keyboard users. If focus becomes trapped inside an interactive widget without an exit key, the user must abandon the session.

nodes.title: BDF Maturity Model & Shift-Left Strategy

buff.name: Cultural Momentum
buff.desc: All correct answers heal the team for +25 HP.

nodes.question: GigaCorp currently fixes accessibility bugs only after receiving threatening legal letters. According to the Business Disability Forum (BDF) Maturity Model, what stage describes this approach?

choices.text: Level 5: Best Practice Leader
Level 1: Reactive / Ad-Hoc Compliance Panic
Level 4: Integrated Sustainable Governance
Level 3: Proactive Design Thinking

nodes.explanation: Level 1 (Reactive) is characterized by isolated, crisis-driven fixes following complaints or lawsuits. Sustainable maturity requires shifting left into policies, hiring, procurement, and ongoing QA.

nodes.title: Universal Design for Learning (UDL) in Enterprise

buff.name: UDL Synergist
buff.desc: Deals +50 bonus damage to the Boss immediately upon unlocking.

nodes.question: What are the three core pedagogical pillars of the Universal Design for Learning (UDL) framework developed by CAST?

choices.text: Multiple Means of Representation, Multiple Means of Action & Expression, and Multiple Means of Engagement.
HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript ECMAScript standards.
Medical diagnosis, legal settlement, and accommodation appeals.
Video captions, high contrast buttons, and tactile braille embossing.

nodes.explanation: CAST's Universal Design for Learning framework is grounded in cognitive neuroscience and structured around 3 principles: Representation (the 'what' of learning), Action & Expression (the 'how'), and Engagement (the 'why').
nodes.cpaccRef: Domain 2.A: Universal Design for Learning (CAST UDL Pillars)

capstone.title: CAPSTONE STRIKE: Enterprise Remediation Masterplan
capstone.question: All 3 shields are shattered! The Vice Chancellor asks for GigaCorp's 3-year enterprise accessibility transformation strategy. Which coordinated blueprint achieves true sustainable organizational maturity?

choices.text: Install a 3rd-party accessibility overlay widget script on all pages and lay off the internal testing team.

Establish an executive-sponsored Central Accessibility Office, institute mandatory ACR vendor audits during procurement, integrate automated & manual screen reader testing into CI/CD, and train staff on UDL and shift-left design.
Require every disabled student to provide notarized medical doctor letters before receiving digital course material.
Re-brand the campus website without changing underlying code, claiming compliance under grandfathering clauses.

capstone.explanation: Sustainable enterprise accessibility requires leadership support, centralized governance, procurement rigor, shift-left development pipelines, and universal design culture—never superficial overlay scripts or medicalized barriers.
capstone.cpaccRef: Domain 2 & 3 Capstone: Enterprise Governance & Shift-Left Strategy
